hook: POV: you run an HVAC company and the property manager texts at *4:52pm*

messages.text: Hi! Your tech is on the schedule for the rooftop units Monday
Can you send your updated certificate of insurance? Ours shows it expired
Can't let anyone on the roof without it

punchline: Renewing it is step one. Sending the *new* one is step two.

cta.title: Never chase an expired COI again
cta.body: CertTrack tracks your licenses, permits and policies and alerts you before they expire.
